parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~26232~~) operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: RestoreOriginalSpecification
parameters.description: The original value. This parameter must be specified when the **ResourceType** parameter is set to **instance**.

parameters.name: TargetValue
parameters.description: The target value. This parameter is available only if you set the ScalingRuleType parameter to TargetTrackingScalingRule or PredictiveScalingRule. The value must be greater than 0 and can contain up to three decimal places.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds modify-custins-resource --db-instance-id rm-j5ekvfeengm000000 --resource-type Memory --increase-ratio 10 --adjust-deadline 2022-12-31_23:59:06 --restore-original-specification 200 --target-value 3000 --region cn-hangzhou
